newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Burns Philp active after share raid.
newsitem.headline: Burns Philp active after share raid.

text.p: Burns Philp and Co Ltd jumped sharply at the start of official trade on Friday after an unidentified buyer purchased 78.16 million shares in the global yeast and spice group at A$2.50.
Brokers reported active trading with the share price rising to A$2.51 before easing to A$2.46 by 10.15 a.m. (0015 GMT), compared with A$2.03 at Thursday's close.
"There's a bit of interest in there," said a Sydney-based dealer.
About a million shares changed hands in early trade.

Earlier on Friday, broker Deutsche Morgan Grenfell (DMG) confirmed it had bought 78.16 million Burns Philp shares, or about 14.7 percent of the group, for a client who was not an international food group.
There has been some recent speculation that Goodman Fielder was considering a takeover bid for Burns Philp.
Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said the client was an overseas-based individual who does not have any food assets at this stage.
